To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Zee mass matrices are characterized by two different resonances, one at high density and one at zero density; that the two resonances can be treated as independent, with the zero density resonance having much larger width and level splitting than the other; and that the Zee mechanism is the only one that leads to such a double resonance.
the propagation in matter of neutrinos with Zee masses can be reduced to a two-neutrino problem and that the Zee mass spectrum has two distinct resonances.

the propagation of the neutrinos in matter generated by the Zeescheme is characterized by a strong suppression of the resonances, and by two different types of resonances, the high density and the zero density resonances.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: 1) the neutrino mass matrix with zero (in general small) diagonal elements; 2) the propagation of neutrinos with this mass matrix; 3) the resonances in neutrino oscillations in vacuum and in matter.
the neutrino propagation in vacuum and in matter.

the following questions: (i) Can we identify the Zee mechanism by studying the neutrino oscillations in matter? (ii) Can we find the Zee parameters from the data on the neutrino oscillation experiments?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neutrino oscillations in vacuum and matter are the only way to identify the Zee mechanism.
the Zee mechanism is the only one that can explain the neutrino oscillations observed by Super-Kamiokande in the atmospheric neutrino data.
neutrino masses are generated by a mechanism different from the Zee mechanism.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Zee mass matrices can explain the solar and atmospheric neutrino data, but not the Super-Kamiokande results.
in the case of the Zee mass matrices the neutrino oscillation phenomena can be treated as the phenomena of the two-neutrino oscillations in the presence of vacuum oscillations.
the neutrino mass matrix with a hierarchy of the nondiagnoal elements is a very interesting object which can be studied by the experiments on the neutrinos from the Sun, supernovae and the Earth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Zee mass mechanism can be tested by the future experiments.
, if the Zee mass-matrix is realized in nature, it will leave a unique signature in the neutrino flavor transitions.
the Zee mass mechanism is a very good candidate to describe the neutrino oscillations.
